description: Authorizes issuance of a new API key after validating requester identity, scope authorization, key lifetime, and issuance risk.

unboundSignalReasons.requesterVerified: Independently attested by identity verification at authentication time; no Intent-side equivalent field exists to bind against.
unboundSignalReasons.scopeAuthorized: Result of an independent entitlement check against the requester's granted scopes; not a value the Intent itself declares.
unboundSignalReasons.riskScore: A computed issuance-risk score (requester history, requested scope breadth), not a value the caller's Intent declares or could be checked against.

outcome.reason: API key issuance authorized. Requester verification, scope authorization, key lifetime, and risk assessment requirements were satisfied.
API key issuance rejected because the assessed issuance risk exceeds the maximum permitted threshold.
API key issuance rejected because the requester's identity has not been verified.
API key issuance rejected because the requested scope is not within the requester's entitlements.
API key issuance rejected because the requested key lifetime exceeds the maximum permitted duration of 90 days.
API key issuance rejected because one or more required policy conditions were not satisfied.
